summary: RFC-0053 takes in a registered store backend (knowledge.backend + backendModule) for ai-sdlc-enterprise RFC-0002 OQ-R6: amendment note, full revision, no key, or reuse the retrieval adapter

options.description: Dated amendment to RFC-0053: OQ-1/OQ-2 stay the open-source default; knowledge.backend + bare-package knowledge.backendModule let an installed package register a store; fails closed; files the only OSS implementation
Full RFC-0053 revision reopening OQ-1 and re-walking R1-R6 of the arcana draft
No key in open source; the enterprise package wraps or forks cli-context

body: Enterprise RFC-0002 OQ-R6 (signed off 2026-11-24) needs open source to ship a backend registration key so an enterprise package can register a remote knowledge store (ENT-15 pre-condition). RFC-0053 (Signed Off) OQ-1/OQ-2 say entries on disk are the store and source of truth. Question: how RFC-0053 records the exception.
